versions.changelog: V2 remediation: add Example Prompts to SKILL.md, Clean Scan Evidence and Install-First Success Path to ACCEPTANCE.md

Initial release of Hydration Habit Tuner – build a flexible, personalized daily water routine.

- Helps users design a simple, sustainable daily water habit using their real schedule and bottle options.
- Builds cues around daily routines (meals, breaks, commutes, etc.) instead of strict tracking or alarms.
- Identifies "dry spells" and friction points, offers easy actions and backup cues.
- Provides a customizable bottle/container plan to fit different routines.
- Includes a 7-day check-in sheet for gentle progress tracking and weekly review.
- Clear health boundaries: not for medical advice or fluid prescription.
